verdict.rationale: Jev's core inputs are natural-language questions, such as the Noul example "Does this message express urgency?", and the Playground lets users paste state and ask those questions without code. An official agent skill for Claude Code and Codex lets users drive Jev integrations by prompting a coding agent. However, the product is operated through typed API and SDK calls (Choice/Score/Noul primitives), not a natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: no first-party natural-language command or chat interface for operating the account or API, the agent skill only helps write code rather than executing operations, and no independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
